math4/place-value-number-sense.title: Number Museum Lock-In
math4/place-value-number-sense.intro: The Number Museum locked its doors with your class inside the place-value gallery! Read, compare and round big numbers to open each display case and get out in 10 minutes.
math4/place-value-number-sense.cipher: THE EXIT KEY IS BEHIND THE GLOBE
math4/place-value-number-sense.outro: COUNT lights up on the last display case and the museum doors swing open. You are place-value pros!

math4/multi-digit-addition-subtraction.title: Bank Vault Balance
math4/multi-digit-addition-subtraction.intro: The bank vault timer started with your class inside! Add and subtract the vault totals to crack each code and walk out in 10 minutes.
math4/multi-digit-addition-subtraction.cipher: THE CODE CARD IS UNDER THE PIGGY BANK
math4/multi-digit-addition-subtraction.outro: The dial spins to COINS and the heavy vault door opens. Every total checks out!

math4/multiplication-strategies.title: Robot Factory Shutdown
math4/multiplication-strategies.intro: The robot factory shut its gates with your team on the assembly line! Multiply to restart each machine and escape in 10 minutes.
math4/multiplication-strategies.cipher: THE POWER SWITCH IS BESIDE THE CRANE
math4/multiplication-strategies.outro: GEARS flashes on the main panel and every robot waves goodbye. Multiplication power restored!

math4/division-remainders.title: Pirate Ship Share-Out
math4/division-remainders.intro: The pirate captain trapped your crew on deck until the treasure is shared fairly! Divide the loot, deal with the leftovers and leave the ship in 10 minutes.
math4/division-remainders.cipher: THE ROWBOAT IS TIED TO THE ANCHOR
math4/division-remainders.outro: CHEST opens the last lock and the crew rows to shore. A fair share for everyone!

math4/factors-multiples-patterns.title: Pattern Palace Puzzle
math4/factors-multiples-patterns.intro: The Pattern Palace sealed its chambers! Find factors, multiples and pattern rules to open each door and get out in 10 minutes.
math4/factors-multiples-patterns.cipher: THE CROWN IS INSIDE THE TOWER
math4/factors-multiples-patterns.outro: PRIME glows on the palace gate and the drawbridge lowers. You cracked every pattern!

math4/fractions-equivalent-fractions.title: Pizza Parlor Mix-Up
math4/fractions-equivalent-fractions.intro: The pizza oven timer locked the kitchen door! Match equivalent fractions and compare slices to unlock each station and leave in 10 minutes.
math4/fractions-equivalent-fractions.cipher: THE SPARE KEY IS UNDER THE APRON
math4/fractions-equivalent-fractions.outro: SLICE unlocks the kitchen door just as the pizzas come out. Fraction chefs for the win!

math4/fraction-operations-decimals.title: Smoothie Stand Scramble
math4/fraction-operations-decimals.intro: The smoothie stand shutters dropped with your team inside! Add fractions and read decimals to mix each order and get out in 10 minutes.
math4/fraction-operations-decimals.cipher: THE SHUTTER HANDLE IS BEHIND THE MANGO
math4/fraction-operations-decimals.outro: BLEND powers the mixer one last time and the shutters roll up. Perfectly measured!

math4/measurement-unit-conversions.title: Camp Measure-It
math4/measurement-unit-conversions.intro: The camp gate is locked until every supply is measured! Convert units, tell time and find areas to open each cabin and hike out in 10 minutes.
math4/measurement-unit-conversions.cipher: THE GATE KEY IS INSIDE THE CANOE
math4/measurement-unit-conversions.outro: SCALE opens the camp gate and the trail home is clear. Measured to perfection!

math4/geometry-angles-symmetry.title: Mirror Maze Mystery
math4/geometry-angles-symmetry.intro: The mirror maze closed behind your class! Measure angles, name shapes and find lines of symmetry to open each hall and escape in 10 minutes.
math4/geometry-angles-symmetry.cipher: THE WAY OUT IS PAST THE PRISM
math4/geometry-angles-symmetry.outro: ANGLE lines up the last mirror and a beam of light points to the exit. Sharp thinking!

math4/data-line-plots-word-problems.title: Science Fair Lockdown
math4/data-line-plots-word-problems.intro: The science fair hall locked after hours with your team inside! Read line plots and solve multi-step problems to clear each booth and get out in 10 minutes.
math4/data-line-plots-word-problems.cipher: THE HALL PASS IS UNDER THE ROBOT
math4/data-line-plots-word-problems.outro: GRAPH unlocks the hall doors and your project wins first place. Data detectives!
